entities.name: Yoan Pablo Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yoan Pablo Hernández Suárez is a Cuban-German former professional boxer who competed between 2005 and 2020. He held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) and the Ring magazine cruiserweight titles between 2011 and 2015. He is the half-brother of Yoel Romero, a freestyle wrestler and mixed martial artist.
